page.overview:
What is Ash's Pikachu?

This Pikachu is an -type Pokémon owned by Ash Ketchum and is his main partner. He picked him as his first partner Pokémon. Pikachu always stayed outside his Poké Ball (with exceptionally rare instances), and could be seen riding on either Ash's head or one of his shoulders, or walking along side him, or being held by Ash a few times.

Despite Pikachu's small size, he is one of Ash's most dependable and strongest partners (if not the strongest). Whenever Ash was not around, Pikachu took a leadership position for the team. He was curious, friendly, intelligent and had shared Ash's fondness for battling. Pikachu was a very determined Pokémon and unwilling to give up in tough situations. He was responsible and often looked after younger Pokémon; particularly Togepi; who he was often forced to shepherd out of danger. Although he is sometimes stubborn, he had obeyed Ash's commands in battle and rarely left his side. Pikachu was also a constant target for Team Rocket. They had tried to capture him many times throughout the series; but on the few occasions that; they did, their plans were always thwarted; by Ash and his friends. Pikachu had often used his Electric-type attacks to escape danger or traps; with Thunderbolt being one of his most common moves. He was very swift in battles as well. He could also imitate some Pokémon; by mimicking their face shapes.

Like Ash himself, Pikachu has a love for science and technology; even; if he cannot understand most of it. Pikachu might be oblivious to the concept of love, as seen; when Dawn's Buneary had tried to flirt; with him.

Pikachu did not like being in his Poké Ball one bit, hated someone pulling on his tail and being followed very closely. He liked riding on Ash's head or one of his shoulders.
